title: Astapable About — Evgenii Astapov
note: Personal about page treated like a product. Outcome carousel (1.5M+ registrations) instead of adjectives; section labels as code comments (`/* My toolkit */`); outside-of-work bento that mimics OS widgets (Photos, Maps, PlayStation, YouTube); persistent "Vibing with Ev" audio pill. Swiss-minimal black type on near-white, with small alive details (live clock, version stamp, morphing cutout).
